types.name: Visa exemption
types.purpose: Tourism or business visits for nationalities exempt from a visa (e.g. Serbia, most of Europe).
types.note: At most 90 days in any 180 days — binding for every foreigner, whatever the visa says. Passport valid 60 days beyond your allowed stay.

types.name: e-Visa
types.purpose: Online visa for tourism or business for eligible nationalities, from the official site evisa.gov.tr only.
types.maxValidity: Usually 180 days, single or multiple entry, for stays of 30 or 90 days
types.note: Only for tourism or commerce. At most 90 days in any 180 days — binding for every foreigner, whatever the visa says. Passport valid 60 days beyond your allowed stay.

types.name: Sticker visa — tourism or business
types.purpose: Tourism, business meetings, conferences, fairs, for those who cannot get an e-Visa.
types.who: Nationals who cannot get an e-Visa
types.note: Consulates issue at most 90 days of stay. At most 90 days in any 180 days — binding for every foreigner, whatever the visa says. Passport valid 60 days beyond your allowed stay.

types.name: Transit visa
types.purpose: Passing through Türkiye to another country (airport or land transit).

types.name: Work visa
types.purpose: Entry to take up a job; a work permit from the Ministry of Labour must be issued.
types.maxValidity: Up to 90 days, then a work permit
types.note: Apply for the work permit within the first days after arrival.

types.name: Study visa
types.purpose: Entry to study at a Turkish school or university; followed by a student residence permit.
types.who: Students accepted by a Turkish school
types.maxValidity: Up to 90 days, then a student residence permit

types.name: Other purpose visas
types.purpose: Journalism, archaeological excavation, documentary filming, official duty, crew, sporting and cultural events.

types.name: Work permit
types.purpose: Working in Türkiye for an employer, or as an independent professional; also counts as a residence permit.
types.maxValidity: Up to 1 year first, then up to 2 and 3 years; indefinite after 8 years

types.name: Turquoise Card
types.purpose: Highly qualified workers, investors, scientists, artists and athletes; leads to indefinite permission.

types.name: Short-term residence permit
types.purpose: Staying longer than 90 days for research, owning a home, business ties, training, exchange programmes, tourism, medical treatment and more.
types.maxValidity: Up to 2 years at a time, renewable
types.note: No day count while the permit is valid.

types.name: Family residence permit
types.purpose: Spouse, children and dependent children of a Turkish citizen or of a foreigner with a residence permit.
types.who: Family of Turkish citizens or residents
types.maxValidity: Up to 3 years at a time

types.name: Student residence permit
types.purpose: Students in associate, bachelor, master or doctoral programmes at Turkish universities.
types.maxValidity: Length of the studies, renewed yearly

types.name: Long-term residence permit
types.purpose: After at least 8 years of continuous legal residence in Türkiye.

types.name: Humanitarian residence permit
types.purpose: Granted in special cases, e.g. the best interest of a child, or when someone cannot be removed.
types.maxValidity: Up to 1 year at a time

types.name: Residence permit for victims of human trafficking
types.purpose: Victims of human trafficking, to recover and decide whether to cooperate with the authorities.
